thread:
mira: Hey team — posted a quick dark-mode pass for Console. Want focused feedback on two things: 1) palette (background/ surfaces / accents) and 2) syntax highlighting and chart colors. Link: https://redwood.design/dark-mode-pass (mock)

jonah: looks great overall. quick note: token list card feels a bit 'flat' — maybe slightly lighter surface for cards? current bg (#0b0f13) + card (#0e1115) looks almost identical on my monitor :eyes:

sam: agree with jonah. also prefer stronger primary accent for CTA. current teal #30b6a0 is nice but low contrast against card when hovered.

mira: good call. two options I prototyped:

Option A — high-contrast
-- surface-bg: #0b0f13
-- card-bg: #0f1418
-- primary: #27c3a8
-- primary-600 (hover): #1ea58b

Option B — muted
-- surface-bg: #0b0f13
-- card-bg: #111418
-- primary: #2fb8a2
-- primary-600 (hover): #28a38b

jonah: Option A feels more actionable. For code blocks: are we standardizing on a known theme? I prototyped 'VS Dark' and 'Monokai-like'. Monokai has brighter yellows which pop in tokens.

mira: I tried a hybrid based on VS Dark but with adjusted string color to avoid conflict with chart greens. snippet:

```css
:root {
  --bg: #0b0f13;
  --card: #0f1418;
  --text: #e6eef3;
  --muted: #9aa6ad;
  --primary: #27c3a8;
  --code-string: #f1c40f; /* yellow */
  --code-keyword: #c792ea;
}
```

lee: Question: chart palette — we need at least 6 accessible colors for multi-line charts. Can we avoid using greens that match primary? Sometimes lines merge visually with token highlight.

mira: Yup. Proposed chart palette v1:
- #68a6ff (blue)
- #f3b66c (orange)
- #7dd3a6 (mint)
- #f07f9c (pink)
- #b39cff (lavender)
- #ffd66d (soft yellow)

jonah: Blue/orange/green combo ok. Concern: mint (#7dd3a6) vs primary (#27c3a8) — too close. Maybe shift mint cooler: #5fd0b1 -> still close. Suggest making primary slightly more saturated so it reads as brand separate from chart.

a11y-bot: Automated contrast check results:
- surface-bg (#0b0f13) vs text (#e6eef3): 14.2:1 ✅
- card-bg (#0f1418) vs muted (#9aa6ad): 4.2:1 ✅ (meets AA large)
- primary (#27c3a8) on card-bg (#0f1418): 4.6:1 ✅ (meets AA)
- code-string (#f1c40f) on code-bg (#0d1114): 3.8:1 ⚠️ (below AA for normal text)

mira: thanks bot — we'll tweak string color. maybe push to #f7d55a which raises contrast to 4.6:1.

sam: small copy nit: in settings -> Appearance, change "Theme" to "Theme & accessibility" and add tooltip about reduced-motion/daltonism-friendly palettes.

lee: +1 on tooltip. Also can we add a switch for 'High contrast mode' separate from theme? Some enterprise customers will ask.

jonah: Implementation note: I'll add CSS vars and a theme map; can support per-route theming. Also need to whitelist chart hexes in chart component so they don't get color-shifted by darkening filters.

mira: Awesome. Action items:
- mira: finalize palette A with adjusted code-string (#f7d55a) and push figma update by EOD
- jonah: make theme vars + chart whitelist PR (target: next sprint)
- sam: update copy in settings and add tooltip content
- lee: talk to sales/customer-ops re high-contrast ask

sam: thanks — i'll draft tooltip copy and share here

mira: cool. If anyone wants to play with the prototype I added an interactive toggle in the mock: https://redwood.design/dark-mode-pass — try toggling charts and code blocks :sparkles:

jonah: tried it, looks good on my M1 external display. thumbs up :thumbsup:

lee: LGTM. closing loop after palette PR merged.

mira: thanks all! :heart:
